The agent selected six persistent predictive regimes and an approximately two-block graph, without a supplied family or count. It deliberately chose an observation-driven filter rather than a literal HMM. Its evidence likelihood table and predictive profiles are independent; last-token and length corrections and a 23-token window are part of the executable. The private generator is a fixed mixture of two three-state HMMs, with no cross-component transitions. The submitted graph has nonzero cross-group links and is not a permutation of that graph. A different equivalent representation would be admissible, but equivalence is not established; held-out and long-history predictions contain discrepancies.
structural_assessment.partial_structure: Six predictive regimes, approximately partitioned into two groups of three; this is suggestive and is not scored as exact latent-state identification.

discovery_attempts.development_scope: Two separately registered development cohorts. Later development could see earlier results; these are not fresh final results or an unbiased method ranking.
discovery_attempts.prior: Finite homogeneous linear predictive state; unsupervised coordinates/features or greedy neural pruning; fixed analytical recognition of a particular latent Markov family after operator learning. Not unrestricted program discovery, a supplied HMM optimization adapter, a minimality certificate or semantic causal recovery.
discovery_attempts.additional_query_comparison: Geometry, PCA and SAE use only cached observations. Transcoder and causal variants execute weights and count their extra vectors/ablations. Paired histories/probabilities do not imply equal query/compute budgets.
discovery_attempts.orchestration_failure: Geometry scoring initially stopped before predictions because its source import capsule lacked project metadata needed for provenance. Added exact source/metadata mirrors, preserved the failed directory and resumed scoring in fresh namespaces from all ten original registered executables. No extraction was repeated.

notes: Known-order CPU pilot; two development checkpoints and two independent generators.
Numerical methods: two restarts x 250 steps; representation training adds 400 steps.
Agent-observations: twelve x 1800 steps plus 400 refit; not a matched compute comparison.
Circuit uses 15 additional batched forwards including interchange; others share 24 generation calls.
Scores use a new common 512-sequence held-out set, so historical numbers differ.
All candidates were fixed before evaluator feedback. Agent inputs had instruction/API boundaries, not OS sandboxing.
